task_text: Aspirate from the 50 mL centrifuge tube with the pipette. The test is a sequence: (1) with the plunger pressed (the thumb's target, action entry `arm1_dh_rh_thj3`, above 0.70 rad), the pipette tip is within 6.5 mm (horizontally) of the tube's axis and more than 5 mm below the liquid surface; (2) the plunger is released (the thumb's target below 0.45 rad) while the tip is still below the surface; (3) success the moment, after (1) and (2), the tip is more than 5 cm above the liquid surface. The tube is part-filled (31.5 mL); the cameras show the liquid as a blue surface inside the tube. No liquid actually moves: the test is on positions and commands.

inventory: 50 mL centrifuge tube, open, part-filled with liquid
pipette with a tip, held by arm1's hand
